text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...It was supposed to be a distance suited for me, though.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: So I still can't catch up to Teio... huh.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I'm nowhere near the President yet.
And besides...”

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I can get even faster!
If it's me... If it's Lord Teio, I know I can!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Time to prepare for the next race right away!
Go, go, go~♪"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You really... make me feel
just how far away you are.
